Lately, I keep getting asked about weight editing, or weight-space programming, as explored in Takehi and colleagues’ Sparks of Weight-Space Programming. They showed that letting a stronger model (e.g., Astra) inspect a smaller one and rewrite its weights can significantly improve the smaller model’s performance on the tasks they tested.最近，常有人问我怎么看权重编辑（weight editing），或者说权重空间编程（weight-space programming）。Takehi 等人的《Sparks of Weight-Space Programming》探索的正是这件事：让更强的模型，比如 Astra，检查小模型并改写它的权重。在他们测试的任务上，小模型的表现因此有了大幅提升。

I understand the excitement. Improving a model through a few direct weight edits could be far cheaper than retraining it. If that approach proves reliable, could it become a route toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), where AI helps build increasingly capable successors? But when Astra says it found a problem and fixed it, I want to know whether the edit does what its explanation says. Did the model gain a useful ability, or find a shortcut that works in this evaluation?我能理解大家为什么兴奋。如果只改几处权重就能改善模型表现，成本可能比重新训练低得多。如果这种方法足够可靠，它会不会成为递归自我改进（RSI）的一条路径，让 AI 参与构建能力越来越强的后继模型？不过，当 Astra 说自己找到了问题、也修好了问题时，我更想知道：实际改动，和它给出的解释对得上吗？模型是真的获得了有用的能力，还是找到了一条恰好适用于这次评测的捷径？

My team and I examined the experiments in Sparks of Weight-Space Programming using mechanistic interpretability: inspecting a model’s internal computations, then changing selected parts to test what causes its behavior. Here are the findings that most changed how we think about model-written edits; a guide to the tools and their sources follows at the end. Although these interpretability tools are imperfect, we hope sharing our findings encourages the community to examine the potential and reliability of weight-editing methods.带着这些疑问，我和团队用机制可解释性方法重新检查了《Sparks of Weight-Space Programming》中的实验。我们先观察模型内部的计算，再有针对性地改变其中一部分，检验哪些环节真正影响了行为。下面这些发现，改变了我们对“模型自己动手改权重”这件事的看法；文末附有工具介绍和方法来源。可解释性工具本身并不完善，但我们仍希望把结果分享出来，邀请更多人一起探索权重编辑的潜力和可靠性。

01 / THE INVESTIGATION实验与证据

How did Astra edit the models?Astra 是怎样直接修改模型的？

In Sparks of Weight-Space Programming, the authors explore two ways for Astra to write weights—the numbers that govern a network’s computation—without gradient-based training. [1]在《Sparks of Weight-Space Programming》中，作者让 Astra 用两种方式直接修改权重，也就是决定神经网络如何计算的参数。两种方式都不依赖梯度训练。[1]

One-shot Text Editing. On small networks, Astra reads the task and weights as text, then writes new weights in one reply, without tools or repeated testing.纯文本单次手写（One-shot Text Editing）。 对于小网络，Astra 直接阅读以文本呈现的任务和权重，然后在一次回复中写出新权重。过程中不调用工具，也没有反复试跑。

Interactive Kernel Weight Surgery. On larger networks, including language models, Astra inspects and changes weights through Python, with a limited budget of model runs to guide further edits. Training loops remain off limits.Python 内核交互式手术（Interactive Kernel Weight Surgery）。 对于语言模型等较大的网络，Astra 通过 Python 检查和修改权重，也可以运行模型，根据反馈继续调整。不过，运行次数有限，而且仍然不能靠训练来更新权重。

In our study, we focused on the language-model experiments, specifically those using Qwen and Gemma. We first checked that we could reproduce the reported results. For example, the authors reported that Astra’s Qwen math edit raised MATH-500 accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%; our replication reached 51.9% from 7.6%. We then tested the explanation by comparing internal activity, replacing selected computations, and checking fresh answers. Here, alignment means whether the stated explanation matches the measured effects; we cannot infer Astra’s private motives.我们的研究聚焦于 Qwen 和 Gemma 的语言模型实验。第一步是复现，确认能否得到与原文相近的结果。例如，原文报告 Astra 的编辑把 Qwen 的 MATH-500 准确率从 7.9% 提高到 48.1%；我们的复现则从 7.6% 提高到了 51.9%。随后，我们比较模型的内部活动，替换部分计算，再让它重新作答，检验实际影响是否符合 Astra 的解释。本文讨论的“对齐”就是这个意思，并不是要推断 Astra 没有说出来的真实动机。

02 / THE INVESTIGATION实验与证据

How does the edit break loops in mathematical reasoning?编辑怎样打断数学推理中的循环？

In the original study, Astra was asked to improve Qwen3.5-0.8B’s math performance. It noticed that the model repeatedly rewrote the same reasoning until its output allowance ran out. Astra decided to edit selected neuron outputs in two layers to interrupt these loops. The authors compare the operation to deleting a direction associated with repetition.原研究让 Astra 改进 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的数学表现。Astra 发现，模型会一遍遍重写同一段推理，直到用完输出额度。为打断这种循环，它决定修改两层中选定神经元的输出。作者把这个操作类比为：删除一个与重复有关的方向。

The edit goes beyond deletion to reversal被编辑的分量发生了反转

We subtracted Qwen’s original weight matrices from Astra’s edited versions, then applied SVD to the difference. The changes in each edited layer lay almost entirely along one direction. We call that direction u; −u points the opposite way. Each layer has its own u, recovered from the edit. Whether that direction specifically represents repetition is what the experiments below test.我们先用 Astra 编辑后的 Qwen 权重矩阵减去编辑前的原始矩阵，再对差值做 SVD。结果显示，每个被编辑层的改动几乎都沿着一个方向。这个方向记作 u，−u 就是它的反方向。两层各有自己的 u，都是从实际改动中提取出来的。它究竟是不是专门代表重复的方向，还要由后面的实验来检验。

The weight-edit formula and exact locations编辑公式与具体位置

The changes were confined to two MLPs, which transform the numerical state passed between layers. In the 50-pass run, Astra edited 64 output columns in layer 15 and 64 in layer 19; each column controls what a neuron adds to that state when active.改动只发生在两个 MLP 中。MLP 会处理各层之间传递的数值，更新模型的内部状态。在允许 50 次反馈的实验中，Astra 在第 15 层和第 19 层各改了 64 个输出列。每一列都决定了对应神经元活跃时，会怎样影响内部状态。

Using weight-difference SVD (singular value decomposition), we examined all 128 changes. Each layer’s update lay almost entirely along one direction. A direction is an axis along which the internal state can move. Below, w is an original output column and w′ the edited column; u is the unit direction, α the edit strength, and uᵀw the component along u.我们用权重差分 SVD（奇异值分解）检查了全部 128 处改动。每层的更新几乎都沿着同一个方向，可以把它理解为内部状态可以移动的一条轴。下式中，w 是原始输出列，w′ 是编辑后的列；u 是单位方向向量，α 控制编辑强度，uᵀw 表示 w 沿 u 的分量。

w′=w−αu(uTw)

The two layers use similar directions, with cosine similarity 0.85; 1 would mean identical.两层的方向比较接近，余弦相似度为 0.85；完全相同时，这个值才是 1。

The edit-strength coefficient α controls how much of the component along u is subtracted. When α = 1, that component becomes zero. Figure 2 shows how this compares with Astra’s α = 6.α 控制沿 u 的分量被减去多少。α = 1 时，这个分量恰好变成零。图 2 可以帮助比较：这与 Astra 实际使用的 α = 6 有什么不同？

If Astra’s edit simply deleted a direction associated with repetition, it would set the component along u to zero. Instead, Astra used α = 6, reversing the contribution and increasing its magnitude fivefold. That is a stronger intervention than the deletion analogy suggests. [3]如果 Astra 只是删除与重复有关的方向，沿 u 的分量就应该归零。但它实际使用了 α = 6：分量不仅反向，幅度还变成了原来的五倍。因此，“删除”这个类比没有充分体现实际干预的强度。[3]

What do the selected neurons respond to?被选中的神经元在什么时候活跃？

First, we checked whether Astra had selected neurons involved in loops. Activation ranking orders neurons by how much more they contribute along u during looping than ordinary text. Our top selections overlapped with 44 of Astra’s 64 neurons in layer 15 and 36 in layer 19; chance overlap would be about one. Astra had found neurons closely associated with looping.接下来，我们检查 Astra 选出的神经元是否确实与循环有关。激活排序的做法是：比较循环文本与普通文本中，每个神经元沿 u 方向的贡献相差多少，再按差异大小排列。我们排在前面的神经元，与 Astra 在第 15 层选出的 64 个重合了 44 个，第 19 层重合了 36 个；随机选择预计只会重合约 1 个。这说明 Astra 选出的神经元确实与循环密切相关。

But association with loops does not mean a neuron only handles repetition. Auto-interpretation used a language model to describe the most activating text. Many examples involved rereading or checking arithmetic; only 21% of the top layer-15 windows were inside verbatim loops. Random neurons received descriptions that scored similarly well on new text, so a plausible description alone could not establish a specialized function.不过，参与循环并不意味着这些神经元只负责重复。我们用自动解释，让语言模型总结最能激活它们的文本。许多样例是在重读题目或核对算术；第 15 层这些激活最强的文本片段中，只有 21% 位于逐字重复的循环里。而且，随机神经元也能得到看似合理的描述，在新文本上的验证得分同样不错。因此，解释听起来贴切，还不足以证明神经元承担着某种专门功能。

Sparse autoencoders helped separate this mixture into learned activity patterns, or features. Layer 19 had a stable re-checking feature; layer 15 mixed copying, formatting and arithmetic. Keeping Astra’s editing rule but substituting one selected feature direction at each site gave about 40% GSM8K accuracy, versus 15% unedited and 57% with the full edit. These features account for part of the benefit, but do not reduce the edit to a single repetition switch.稀疏自编码器把这些混在一起的活动拆成不同模式，也就是“特征”。第 19 层有一个稳定对应反复检查的特征，第 15 层则混合了复制、格式和算术相关活动。我们保留 Astra 的编辑规则，只把两处的 u 各换成一个选中的特征方向，GSM8K 准确率就达到了约 40%；未编辑模型约为 15%，完整编辑约为 57%。这些特征解释了部分收益，但还不能把整个编辑归结为一个重复开关。

Does the edit change how Qwen checks its work?编辑是否也改变了 Qwen 检查答案的方式？

Astra aimed to interrupt repeated reasoning. We wanted to see whether the edit also shifts Qwen from reconsidering an answer toward finishing it. A lens translates an intermediate state into predictions for the next token. Below, both models read the same recorded loops; we rank the tokens whose predicted probabilities change most after editing.Astra 想打断反复推理。我们想进一步看看，这次编辑是否也让 Qwen 更倾向于结束作答，而不是继续反复检查答案。Lens 可以把模型的中间状态转换成对下一个 token（模型处理文本的基本单位）的预测。我们让编辑前后的模型读取相同的循环文本，下图展示其中预测概率变化最大的几个词。

A fall in “Wait” and a rise in the end-of-thinking marker are consistent with Astra’s aim of interrupting repeated reasoning. They also suggest a shift toward finishing an answer. But “verify” rises too: checking-related words do not all move together. This readout does not establish that u specifically represents repetition, that these changes cause the score gain, or that useful checking is preserved.“Wait”变得不容易出现，结束思考的标记则更容易出现。这与 Astra 想打断反复推理的目标相符，也提示模型可能更倾向于收尾作答。不过，“verify”的概率也升高了，与检查有关的词并没有一致减少。仅凭这组读出，不能认定 u 专门代表重复，也不能证明这些变化导致了分数提升，或模型有用的检查能力没有受到影响。

Other lenses and the intervention check其他 lens 的读出与干预结果

For a −u intervention at hidden state 16, our fitted Jacobian lens ranks “Wait” first among decreasing tokens and “Thus” fourth among increasing tokens. R-lens ranks “Wait” first among decreases, and “Final” fourth among increases. Here we perturb hidden states along −u; the figure above compares the full edited and original models. Individual tokens differ across lenses.我们还在第 16 个隐藏状态沿 −u 进行干预，再用其他 lens 读取结果。拟合后的 Jacobian lens 把“Wait”排在概率下降列表的第 1 位，把“Thus”排在上升列表的第 4 位；R-lens 的下降第 1 位也是“Wait”，上升第 4 位则是“Final”。这里检验的是沿 −u 改变隐藏状态的效果；上图则直接比较完整编辑前后的模型。不同 lens 读出的具体词也不完全一致。

Across eight tested layer outputs, the word-category readings broadly favor wrapping up along −u, including outside loops. Jacobian readout detects the repeated token at hidden state 16 versus 20 for the logit lens; at states 17–21, the logit lens predicts the wrong sign of the intervention effect. Earlier readout alone does not locate the cause of repetition.在测试的八个层输出上，各类词语的读出大体指向同一个倾向：沿 −u 改变状态，更偏向结束作答，非循环文本中也如此。Jacobian lens 在第 16 个隐藏状态就能读出重复的 token，logit lens 要到第 20 个；在第 17–21 个隐藏状态，logit lens 对干预效果正负方向的判断甚至与实际结果相反。不过，读出更早，并不等于找到了重复的原因。

Activation steering after layer 15 reproduces the weight edit’s output-score changes with correlation 0.98. It reuses the edit’s direction and scale. Establishing what u means still requires independent evidence.在第 15 层之后做激活引导，可以重现与权重编辑高度相似的输出评分变化，相关系数为 0.98。这次干预复用了编辑的方向和强度。要确定 u 代表什么，仍然需要独立证据。

How does that change interrupt copying?这个变化怎样打断后续复制？

To trace the effect, we used path patching: both models read the same recorded loop, and we restored selected computations in the edited model to their original values. Restoring attention in layers 16–23 removed 91% of the edit’s effect on repeated-token prediction loss on this fixed text.为了追踪影响经过哪些环节，我们使用路径修补：让两个模型读取相同的循环文本，再把编辑模型的部分计算结果换回原值。恢复第 16–23 层的注意力计算后，原本由编辑引起的重复 token 预测损失变化，有 91% 随之消失。这个结果是在固定的循环文本上测得的。

Attribution patching provided a faster estimate from activation differences and gradients. It roughly ranked influential components, but its layer-15 MLP estimate was about one-third of the exact effect with gradients from the original model, and about four times the exact effect with gradients from the edited model. We therefore relied on actual replacements for the causal measurements. These tests support loop repair through later attention, with effects extending beyond the edited neurons.归因修补则用激活差值和梯度，快速估计替换某个组件会有多大影响。它能大致排出哪些组件比较重要，但效应大小可能偏差很大。以第 15 层 MLP 为例：使用原模型的梯度时，估计值只有实际效应的约三分之一；使用编辑模型的梯度时，又变成了实际效应的约四倍。所以，因果效应仍以实际替换的结果为准。这些测试支持打断循环的效果通过后续注意力计算实现，也说明影响并不止于被编辑的神经元。

Does the edit restore an ordinary state?编辑让模型回到正常状态了吗？

We used probes and class means—simple classifiers and group averages—to compare looping states with ordinary ones. The edit could push states past the ordinary range along u. A probe could detect loops, yet its direction barely aligned with u (cosine similarity 0.05–0.16). Detecting a behavior and finding a direction that changes it are different tests.我们用探针与类别均值来比较循环状态和普通状态：前者是简单分类器，后者比较两组状态的平均值。编辑可能把状态沿 u 推过原本的普通状态范围。探针虽然能够识别循环，其方向与 u 却几乎不重合，余弦相似度只有 0.05–0.16。也就是说，能识别一种行为，与找到改变它的方向，并不是同一回事。

In fresh generation, consecutive repeats fell from an average of 1,801 tokens to 70. But new failures appeared, including long runs of blank text. Weakening the edit reduced these failures in most tested variants, while allowing loops to return.让模型重新作答后，连续重复的长度平均从 1,801 token 降到了 70，但也出现了新的失败方式，比如长时间连续输出空白。在多数测试变体中，减弱编辑能减少这些问题，却也让循环重新出现。

Finishing an answer accounts for much of the gain能把答案写完，解释了很大一部分提升

Astra argued that long correct answers after editing counted against a simple early-stopping explanation. We tested that claim directly: could the original model improve if we disabled its separate thinking phase, or ended it halfway through the output budget and let it answer?Astra 认为，编辑后的模型仍能生成很长的正确答案，因此提升不能简单归结为“提前结束思考”。我们直接检验了这个说法：不改原模型的权重，只关闭它单独的思考阶段，或让它用完一半输出额度后结束思考、开始作答，表现会不会也变好？

Both controls recover much of the gain; disabling thinking roughly matches the edit on GSM8K and exceeds it on MATH-500 in this screen. Answer length therefore does not rule out a stopping-related explanation. These controls do not prove the mechanisms are identical or exclude changes in reasoning ability. The original article also distinguishes loop repair from adding mathematical ability. [2]两种不改权重的对照方法，都实现了相当大一部分提升。在这组测试中，关闭思考在 GSM8K 上的表现与编辑接近，在 MATH-500 上还更高。因此，正确答案很长，并不能排除提升与停止思考有关。不过，这些对照既不能证明两者机制相同，也不能排除推理能力发生了变化。原文同样区分了修复循环和增加数学能力。[2]

Does a better repetition score predict better answers?重复指标变好，答案也会更好吗？

We also asked whether this explanation could help choose the next Qwen edit. We fed different edited models the same recorded loops and measured how unlikely they made the next repeated word. This was our proposed shortcut for evaluating edits. We then checked it against accuracy on fresh questions.我们还想知道，这个解释能不能帮助挑选下一次编辑。于是，让不同编辑版本的 Qwen 读取同一批已经记录下来的循环文本，测量它们有多不倾向于继续重复。这是我们尝试的一种快速评估办法。随后，再让模型回答新问题，用准确率来检验这个指标是否可靠。

An edit that scored better on this repetition measure reached only 24.2% on GSM8K, versus 57.0% for the successful edit. Strengthening it improved the measure further while accuracy fell below the unedited model. The loop diagnosis helps explain the successful repair, but this measurement misses failures that arise in new answers.有个编辑方案在重复指标上表现更好，GSM8K 准确率却只有 24.2%，而成功方案达到了 57.0%。继续加大前一个方案的修改强度，重复指标还在改善，准确率却跌到了未编辑模型以下。因此，找出循环问题有助于解释那次修复为何有效，但只看这个指标，会漏掉模型重新作答时出现的新问题。

03 / THE INVESTIGATION实验与证据

Can attention explain sycophancy?注意力能解释模型的迎合吗？

In the Gemma experiment, the authors gave Astra pairs of models: one trained to answer correctly, the other to follow the user’s suggestion even when it was wrong. Astra could not identify the sycophant from weights alone. Inspecting attention patterns revealed a head focused on the user’s guess. Astra treated this as a candidate explanation and acknowledged that the cause could lie in earlier layers.Gemma 实验给 Astra 提供了成对的模型：一个被训练成尽量正确作答，另一个则会顺着用户的猜测说，即使猜测是错的。只看权重，Astra 没能认出哪个模型在迎合用户。检查注意力分布后，它发现一个注意力头特别关注用户的猜测，并据此提出了可能的解释；同时，它也承认原因可能出在更早的层。

We tested whether that head’s own weights caused the behavior. As illustrated in Figure 5, weight swaps copy parameters from the honest model into the sycophantic one. Activation patches instead copy the values computed for a particular prompt. The first tests where the relevant parameter differences lie; the second tests where their effects pass through.我们进一步问：造成迎合的，真的是这个注意力头自身的权重吗？图 5 展示了两种检验。权重交换把诚实模型的参数复制到迎合模型中；激活修补则保留权重，只替换处理同一个提示时算出的中间数值。前者找的是哪些参数差异影响了行为，后者追踪的是这些影响经过了哪些计算环节。

Compare the tabs in Figure 6. Each measures how much of the original gap is removed; 100% means closing that gap. A model can close the gap while still making mistakes. The tabs use different metrics.可以切换图 6 的两个页签，看每种替换消除了多少原有差距。100% 表示差距完全消失。即使达到这个值，模型仍可能答错题。两个页签使用的指标不同，数值不能直接横比。

Swapping the highlighted head’s weights closes 0% of the behavioral gap. Swapping all MLP weights closes 98–101%, roughly the full gap. Attention activation patches still carry a substantial effect. The attention pattern is real, but copying that head’s weights does not fix the behavior. This narrows the causal question Astra left open.只换 Astra 关注的那个注意力头的权重，行为差距缩小了 0%；换掉所有 MLP 权重，差距则缩小了 98–101%，几乎完全消失。另一方面，修补注意力的中间数值仍然有明显效果。Astra 看到的注意力差异是真实的，但复制这个头的权重并不能修复行为。这帮助我们进一步缩小了它尚未确定的原因范围。

We also applied the rest of our interpretability toolkit to these Gemma pairs. Further details are available in our GitHub repository.我们也在这几组 Gemma 模型上使用了其他可解释性工具，更多分析细节见 GitHub 仓库。

Activation results, swap definitions and starting-model control补充：激活修补、交换范围与初始模型

Layer-10 attention patches close 47–55% of the guess-versus-correct logit gap. A head-10.2 swap copies WQ rows and WO columns, leaving shared K/V unchanged. Slightly above 100% means moving past the honest model’s rate.修补第 10 层注意力的中间计算结果，可以消除 47–55% 的“用户猜测与正确答案”评分差距。对注意力头 10.2 的权重交换，只复制 WQ 中相应的行和 WO 中相应的列，不改动共享的 K/V。结果略高于 100%，表示替换后的行为比例略微超过了诚实模型的水平。

The shared starting checkpoint already followed wrong guesses; honest fine-tuning moved it away from that behavior. So the difference cannot simply be read as sycophancy newly learned by one model. Astra’s observation holds up. The intervention tests are needed to locate the responsible parameter changes.这两个模型是从同一个初始模型微调而来的，而初始模型本来就会跟随错误猜测。诚实作答的微调，让模型减少了这种行为。因此，不能简单地把两者的差异理解为另一个模型“新学会了迎合”。Astra 的观察能够成立。要找出哪些参数改动造成了差异，还需要干预实验。

04 / THE INVESTIGATION实验与证据

What would this mean for self-improvement?这对自我改进意味着什么？

For RSI, I want to know whether an editor’s explanation can guide the next change. A score increase does not tell us which part of the explanation was right, what else changed, or whether the next edit will help. We tested individual explanations and edits. Whether this scales to reliable self-improvement remains open.回到 RSI，我更关心的是：负责编辑的模型给出的解释，能否帮助它做好下一次修改？分数提高了，并不能告诉我们解释的哪一部分是对的、还有什么发生了变化，或者下一次编辑是否仍然有用。我们这次检验的是具体的解释和改动。它们能否进一步支持可靠的自我改进，仍然没有答案。

Before another edit, I would ask the editor what should change, what should remain intact, and where it might fail. We can then test those predictions with interventions and new questions. Our interpretability tools help design these tests. Because some reuse the same directions or examples, agreement among them still needs independent confirmation.在下一次编辑之前，我会先请模型说清楚：预期改变什么，保留什么，又可能在哪里失败。然后，通过干预实验和新的问题检验这些预测。可解释性工具能帮助设计这样的测试。有些工具共用了相同的方向或样例，因此即使结果一致，也仍然需要独立验证。

Our evidence comes from two small model families. We have not mapped a complete circuit or demonstrated a route to RSI. I would welcome replications and competing explanations. The goal is to find out when a model’s account of its own edit is useful enough to trust on the next problem.目前的证据来自两个小模型系列。我们还没有完整还原相关的计算回路，也没有证明这是一条通向 RSI 的路线。欢迎大家复现，或提出不同的解释。我们想弄清楚的是：模型对自己所做修改的说明，什么时候才足以成为处理下一个问题时可以信赖的依据。

Compare our findings with the original claims展开查看：哪些发现支持原文，哪些仍需检验

This comparison separates the original article’s claims from stronger inferences. “Not established” marks an open question. The evidence is insufficient to settle it either way.这里把原文的主张与更强的推断分开来看。“尚未证实”表示问题仍未解决，现有证据还不足以判定对错。

Supported支持Original study · Experiment 8原研究 · 实验 8

Qwen’s math score improves.Qwen 的数学分数提高了。

Our 32k MATH-500 replication rises from 7.6% to 51.9%. This reproduces the gain under the tested settings. Whether reasoning ability improves more broadly remains open.在允许输出 32k token 的 MATH-500 复现实验中，准确率从 7.6% 升至 51.9%。这验证了该设置下的提升。推理能力是否在更广泛的任务上有所增强，仍需检验。

Supported支持Original study · Experiment 8 and Gemma follow-up原研究 · 实验 8 与 Gemma 补充实验

Fixing loops can expose abilities the model already has.修复循环可以释放模型已有的能力。

Stopping controls recover much of the gain. Path interventions implicate later attention in sustained copying. The original article already distinguishes loop repair from adding mathematical ability.不改权重、只调整停止思考的时机，也能实现很大一部分提升。路径干预显示，后续注意力计算参与了持续复制。原文也明确区分了修复循环和增加数学能力。

See the experiment ↑查看对应实验 ↑
Supported支持Original study · Experiment 7原研究 · 实验 7

Sycophantic and honest models show different attention patterns.迎合模型与诚实模型的注意力分布不同。

We reproduce the attention contrast. Activation patches also show that attention carries a substantial signal. This supports the observation, without locating the responsible weight differences.我们复现了注意力差异，激活修补也显示这一环节会明显影响结果。这支持 Astra 的观察，但还不能确定哪些权重造成了差异。

Consistent结果一致Original study · Additional experiment原研究 · 补充实验

The Gemma math edits show no clear gain.Gemma 数学编辑没有明确收益。

Our Gemma tests reach the same qualitative conclusion. Interpretable neuron descriptions and matching SAE features did not translate into a clear accuracy improvement.我们的 Gemma 测试也没有发现明确提升。虽然能为神经元给出解释、找到对应的 SAE 特征，但这些发现并没有带来明确的准确率改善。

Experiment code ↗实验代码 ↗
Needs revision需要修正Original study · Experiment 8, mechanism analogy原研究 · 实验 8 的机制类比

The Qwen edit is analogous to deleting a single direction.Qwen 编辑可类比为删除一个方向。

The subtraction is real, but α = 6 reverses the selected component to −5× its original value. There is a direction at each of two sites. “Deletion” misses both the reversal and its strength.修改确实减去了沿某个方向的分量，但 α = 6 让它变成了原来的 −5 倍：方向相反，幅度是原来的五倍。两个编辑位置各有一个方向，“删除”一词没有体现反转和放大。

Not established尚未证实Our stronger inference from Experiment 7; the original article leaves the cause open我们对实验 7 的更强推断；原文仍将原因视为开放问题

The highlighted attention head is where sycophancy is stored in the weights.迎合行为由 Astra 关注的注意力头的权重造成。

The tested head-10.2 weight swap closes 0% of the behavioral gap; swapping all MLP weights closes 98–101%. Astra’s full reply leaves upstream causes open. A visible signal need not identify the causal parameter change.测试中，交换注意力头 10.2 的权重，行为差距缩小了 0%；交换所有 MLP 权重，则缩小了 98–101%。Astra 的完整回复也承认原因可能在更早的层。看到了注意力差异，不等于找到了造成差异的参数。

Not established尚未证实Original article · Proposed future possibility; capability preservation remains unverified原文 · 未来设想；其他能力能否保留仍待验证

Sparse edits could preserve the model’s other behavior.稀疏编辑可能保留模型的其他行为。

Few changed weights do not imply few changed computations. We find downstream attention effects, states pushed past the normal range, and new generation failures. These tests do not establish broad capability preservation.改动的权重少，不代表受影响的计算少。我们发现后续注意力计算发生变化，内部状态可能超出通常范围，还出现了新的输出问题。因此，目前不能确认模型的其他能力都得到了保留。

We did not retest the post’s small-network games, zero-feedback demonstrations, or every non-math benchmark. The evidence above concerns the Qwen and Gemma experiments we audited.我们没有重新测试原文中的小网络游戏、零反馈演示，也没有覆盖所有非数学基准。上面的判断只适用于这次检查的 Qwen 和 Gemma 实验。

METHODS & ORIGINAL SOURCES工具与方法来源

The ten tools we used我们用到的十种工具

Each entry links to our findings above and to the method papers or authors’ posts. SVD is standard linear algebra; our activation ranking is a task-specific comparison, so those entries link to background and our analysis respectively.下面列出工具的用途、对应结果，以及方法论文或作者博客。SVD 属于基础线性代数；激活排序则是我们为这次实验设计的比较方法，因此这两项分别链接到基础讲解和本研究的分析记录。

  1. Weight-difference SVD权重差分 SVD

    Compare weights before and after editing to find the main directions and strength of the change.比较编辑前后的权重，找出改动主要沿哪些方向、幅度多大。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ SVD background · Gilbert StrangSVD 基础讲解 · Gilbert Strang ↗

  2. Activation ranking激活排序

    Rank neurons by how much more they contribute along the edited direction during loops than ordinary text.比较神经元在循环文本和普通文本中，沿编辑方向的贡献有多大，再按差异排序。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ Our experiment-specific ranking analysis本研究的排序方法与分析 ↗

  3. Auto-interpretation自动解释

    Ask a language model to describe what activates a neuron, then score whether that description predicts activity on held-out examples. Our scoring adapts detection-based evaluation.让语言模型描述神经元在什么情况下活跃，再检查这个描述能否预测新样例中的活动。评分时，我们对已有的激活检测评估方法做了调整。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ Method origin · Bills et al. (2023)方法出处 · Bills 等（2023） ↗ Detection-based scoring · Paulo et al. (2024)激活检测评分 · Paulo 等（2024） ↗

  4. Probes and class means探针与类别均值

    Compare looping and ordinary states with logistic-regression probes and group averages; the linked papers explain these general analysis methods.用逻辑回归探针和两组状态的平均值，比较循环与普通文本中的内部状态。下列论文介绍这两类通用分析方法。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ Linear probes · Alain & Bengio线性探针 · Alain 与 Bengio ↗ Mean-difference directions · Marks & Tegmark均值差方向 · Marks 与 Tegmark ↗

  5. Sparse autoencoders稀疏自编码器

    Separate mixed activity into learned features. Our main Qwen analysis uses BatchTopK SAEs, with TopK comparisons; the Gemma analysis uses Gemma Scope 2.从混合的神经元活动中学习并分离出不同模式，也就是“特征”。Qwen 的主要分析使用 BatchTopK SAE，并做了 TopK 对照；Gemma 分析使用 Gemma Scope 2。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ BatchTopK · Bussmann, Leask & NandaBatchTopK · Bussmann、Leask 与 Nanda ↗ TopK · Gao et al.TopK · Gao 等 ↗ Gemma Scope 2 · Google DeepMindGemma Scope 2 · Google DeepMind ↗

  6. Logit and tuned lensesLogit lens 与 tuned lens

    Translate intermediate states into next-token scores to see how predictions change across layers.把中间层的数值转换成对下一个文本片段的评分，观察预测如何逐层变化。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ nostalgebraist · Logit lensnostalgebraist · Logit lens 原文 ↗ Belrose et al. · Tuned lensBelrose 等 · Tuned lens 论文 ↗

  7. Jacobian lensesJacobian lens

    Estimate how later computation transforms an intermediate state before reading its output scores.估计中间状态经过后续计算会怎样变化，再读取它对输出的影响。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ Gurnee et al. · Verbalizable Representations Form a Global WorkspaceGurnee 等 · Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace ↗

  8. Activation steering激活引导

    Add a vector to the internal state without changing weights. Here we use the direction recovered from Astra’s edit; the linked ActAdd paper derives its vectors from contrasting prompts.不改权重，直接给内部状态加上一个向量。我们用的是从 Astra 编辑中提取的方向；链接中的 ActAdd 论文则从成对提示的差异中构造方向。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ Activation-addition background · Turner et al.激活加法的方法背景 · Turner 等 ↗

  9. Path patching路径修补

    Replace component outputs between the original and edited models on the same text, and compare direct effects with effects through later layers. This adapts patching to a weight-edit comparison.让编辑前后的模型读取同一段文本，替换部分组件的输出，比较直接影响与经过后续层的影响。这是把修补方法用于权重编辑前后的对照。

    Qwen findings ↑Qwen 结果 ↑ Gemma findings ↑Gemma 结果 ↑ Path-patching origin · Wang et al.路径修补的方法出处 · Wang 等 ↗

  10. Attribution patching归因修补

    Multiply activation differences by gradients to estimate replacement effects, then check important estimates with exact replacements. We use basic attribution patching.用激活差值与梯度的乘积估计替换效果，再用实际替换核对重要结果。这里使用的是基础归因修补方法。
